# Bestbuy

Best Buy offers a suite of APIs providing access to product, store, category, and recommendation data.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bestbuy/.

## Actions

- **Get Best Buy Stores** (read-only): Retrieve a list of best buy stores.
- **Get Categories** (read-only): Retrieve best buy product categories.
- **Get Category Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a best buy category by its id.
- **Get Product Details by SKU** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific product by sku.
- **Get Product Reviews** (read-only): Retrieve product reviews.
- **Get Products** (read-only): Retrieve products from best buy.
- **Get Review Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific review by id.
- **Get Store Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific best buy store.
